gemma_9b_audit.executive_summary: DLF Phase 4 (Sector 28) is a mature, high-convenience residential micro-market ideal for families prioritizing top-tier schooling, metro walkability, and established social infrastructure, though buyers must account for high entry prices (₹22,500/sq.ft) and seasonal NCR air quality challenges.
key_strengths: Immediate proximity to premier schools (The Shri Ram School Aravali, Ridge Valley) and tertiary hospitals (Fortis, Max) within a 2.5 km radius.
High grid reliability (only ~1.5 hrs/week DHBVN outage) reinforced by 100% society-level diesel generator backup.
Walkable commercial and transit access via Galleria Market and nearby Yellow Line & Rapid Metro stations.
red_flags: Elevated particulate exposure (US AQI 168, PM2.5 at 82.4 µg/m³) requires indoor air filtration for children and seniors.
Localized monsoon waterlogging along internal collector roads near Hamilton Court during intense July-August rainfall.
Peak-hour traffic congestion around Galleria Market and Chakkarpur entry corridors.
gemma_9b_audit.infrastructure_outlook: High stability with incremental civic upgrades: GMDA master drainage de-silting and the upcoming Gurugram Metro loop connecting Millennium City Centre to Cyber City will further reduce dependency on private vehicles over the next 3-5 years.
gemma_9b_audit.buyer_verdict: Strong Buy for end-user families seeking immediate livability and low execution risk over speculative construction zones.
